Questions owners ask first

Not seeing yours? Ask it on the scan, or email nikhil@clearbyfive.com.

What happens on the 20-minute scan?

We talk through how leads, quotes, dispatch, and reporting run in your shop today. By the end, you’ll know if there’s a workflow worth auditing. If there isn’t, we’ll tell you.

Do we have to switch software?

No. We work inside the tools you already run, like ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, QuickBooks, and Google Workspace.

What does it cost?

The scan is free. The 7-day audit is $2,500 at our founding-partner price. If you go on to build with us, the full $2,500 is credited toward it.

What if the audit doesn’t find much?

If we can’t find at least $25,000 a year in credible value, you get the $2,500 back.

Does my team need to be technical?

No. We build it, document it, and train the people who will use it day to day.
